purpose: Re-parse daily sample rows using the confirmed M/D/YYYY market_date, exclude only verified trailing all-column-empty padding, keep quote_datetime opaque, and test whether the 19-column and 25-column members contain identical core trade rows and usable contemporaneous NBBO-side fields.
decision: A daily sample-level measurement may be feasible without assigning a meaning to the time-only field. Exact bid/ask prints remain candidate aggressor-side proxies only. Trade-condition mapping, adjusted deliverables, first receipt, historical coverage and PIT admission remain separate gates.
